newsitem.title: CYPRUS: AIDS case Cypriot was open about illness - witness.
newsitem.headline: AIDS case Cypriot was open about illness - witness.

text.p: A Greek Cypriot accused of transmitting the deadly AIDS virus to his British lover never made a secret of the fact he had the syndrome, a Cyprus court heard on Friday.

"From what I am aware he used to talk about his condition," said Evridiki Lazarou, a state medical officer testifying for the prosecution in the case against fisherman Pavlos Georgiou, 40, a carrier of HIV which leads to Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome.
"In several cases when I was present I noticed that with other relatives of persons being treated at the (AIDS) clinic he spoke very openly about it," she told the district court of Famagusta.
Georgiou, a local fisherman, has been accused by former lover Janette Pink, 45, of keeping her in the dark about his condition during their affair in Cyprus, which started in early 1994.
Pink claims that by the time she did find out from relatives of her lover, in October 1994, she was already HIV positive. Pink, from Basildon in Essex, is now suffering from full-blown AIDS.

Georgiou has been charged with negligently spreading the transmission of a life-threatening disease. He has denied the charge, which carries a maximum sentence of up to two years in prison or a 1,500 Cyprus pounds ($3,000) fine.
Lazarou, a sister at the Makarios III hospital in the capital Nicosia, carries out AIDS tests and is in charge of counselling.
She said Georgiou, a father of four whose youngest son is HIV positive, was diagnosed positive in July 1992.

"At the beginning he was in shock. Then he started to understand what was happening... what impressed me was when I told him he would need to take precautions during sexual intercourse he was most emphatic that he would," said Lazarou, adding that the Health Ministry also gave him condoms.

Pink has claimed that throughout their affair Georgiou never used a condom, one means of minimising the risk of infection. Georgiou says Pink always insisted on intercourse without using one. The hearing continues on June 25.
